text:
Maya: cron eval run at 03:00 failed — 3/25 tests failed, looks like a mix of OOM + a latency spike. artifacts: s3://redwood-eval/1870001229/ — anyone able to triage? cc @Igor
cron-bot: Job failed: eval-suite (run id 1870001229). Logs + artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-eval/1870001229/ and CI: https://ci.redwood/invocations/1870001229
Sam: quick skim of the logs: the failures are "latency_smoke_test" x2 (one spike, one timeout) and "correctness_subsets" x1 with a CUDA OOM on a2-highmem while running model redwood-small-v2-quant
Igor: I'll take it. Maya can you paste the failing stacktrace / docker log snippet here? also which model hashes were used? :thinking_face:
Maya: sure — here's the OOM snippet from worker-5:
```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 1.24 GiB (GPU 0; 23.6 GiB total capacity; 20.1 GiB already allocated)
  File "/app/eval/harness.py", line 412, in run_test
    outputs = model.generate(batch)
  File "/app/venv/lib/python3.10/site-packages/torch/nn/modules/module.py", line 1190, in _call_impl
    return forward_call(*args, **kwargs)
```
Model in run: redwood-small-v2-quant @ abc123f (note: earlier CI runs used abc122f)
Ashley: we did change batching in the eval harness in PR #4123 (reduced per-shard buffering). could be related if quantized kernels behave differently under different batch packing :/
Sam: artifact metadata shows batch_size=8, seq_len=1024, shard_count=8. The failing node was a2-highmem-07. You can rerun a single test locally with: `./tools/run_eval --test latency_smoke_test --model abc123f --node a2-highmem-07`
Igor: I'll kick a CI rerun for just the failed tests with `./ci/run --suite eval-suite --filter "latency_smoke_test|correctness_subsets" --rerun-failed --pin-model abc123f` and also try a local reproducer. reserving GPU now.
Maya: if rerun passes, let's mark the two latency failures as flaky and loosen the threshold. if rerun fails, we'll bisect PRs touching eval harness between 4100..4130. can someone reserve A2 for 30m? :clock1:
Sam: reserved a2-highmem-0123 for 45m and tagged it in infra-jira. ping me if you need more time. :thumbsup:
Igor: rerun kicked: https://ci.redwood/invocations/1870001247 — note a small log I saw in worker logs: "KV cache miss on shard 7 at step 102" — could point to nondeterministic sharding in the quantized path
cron-bot: Rerun finished (invocation 1870001247). Summary: all tests passed except a single tail-latency spike in latency_smoke_test (p95 -> p99 gap). Full report: s3://redwood-eval/1870001247/report.html
Maya: thanks — looks like no hard correctness regression. Igor, please open a follow-up issue to (1) mark the two tests as flaky, (2) add a CI rerun for latency flakiness, and (3) include the KV miss logs. Assign to Sam for infra pin and Ashley for PR context.
Igor: will do. opening issue now (#856) and attaching logs + links. tagging @Ashley for PR 4123 context.
Ashley: thanks — I'll review PR 4123 and the quantization packing notes after lunch. if there's a quick fix we can roll it to canary.
Maya: perfect. leaving this thread open for postmortem notes. thanks everyone for quick triage :heart:
